svg.title: Motorhome policy versus a towable trailer while hitched
svg.desc: A motorhome carries its own liability and physical damage. A travel trailer usually needs its own physical-damage policy, while liability while it is attached often follows the tow vehicle. Full-time living, United States day caps, and peer rental are separate disclosures.
svg.text: Two units, two jobs, while you are towing
Aviva RV pages used 24 Sep 2026 describe product shapes. Your certificate controls.
Pleasure, seasonal, and full-time living are different rates. Say which one is true.
Aviva's RVLife description includes 180 U.S. days, with an optional further 180. That is one insurer, not a statute.
Mexico is off many Canadian RV certificates. Do not borrow a United States endorsement for a Mexican road.
Awnings, solar, and generators often need a schedule. Peer-rental use needs disclosure before the first guest.
A lay-up discount applies only for the months the unit is off the road, on the terms the insurer writes down.
